test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cd693028c9307ad7afbe8bc1c44c004abef74d472b87af85e4d6e807fb4bbcb.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The left diagonal elements shift anticlockwise.

The first two elements of the right diagonal elements from the top interchange positions.

The last two elements of the right diagonal elements from the top interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f7502d45ee2bd61f33107cba6327c2bed815c1b041cc2ab05d02a9285ff8e61.png] 

2) Second box series →

The right diagonal elements shift clockwise.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d42e092eb7dcc1166f2cc0f397ff37ba152669b23a475c6a2d94d75b151ecc6.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82de1be60f5964c1457a2dbec9c1f51bee459510d84806fe214fd6908bee263f.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
